LMcode CLI (Rust rewrite)

Usage: lm [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]... [COMMAND]

Commands:
  export   导出会话为 ZIP 压缩包。
  channel  管理 cc-connect 消息平台通道。
  migrate  将旧版 lmcode-cli 安装的数据迁移到 lmcode。（已停用）
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [PROMPT]...
          One-shot prompt text (same as `-p`; quote multi-word prompts)

Options:
  -p, --prompt [<PROMPT>]
          Run a single prompt non-interactively and exit. A bare `-p` still means prompt mode (validated as an empty prompt, like the legacy CLI)

  -m, --model <MODEL>
          Model alias from config.toml (defaults to `default_model`)

      --config <CONFIG>
          Path to config.toml (defaults to $LMCODE_HOME/config.toml or ~/.lmcode/config.toml)

  -y, --yolo
          Auto-approve every tool call (non-interactive / automation mode)

      --auto
          Start in auto permission mode: non-sensitive calls are approved without prompting; calls touching sensitive paths still ask

  -C, --continue
          Continue the most recent session for this directory
          
          [alias: -c]

  -S, --session [<ID>]
          Resume a session: with an ID, load that session; without one, the most recent session for this directory

  -r, --resume [<ID>]
          Alias of `-S/--session`

      --plan
          Start in plan mode

      --skills-dir <DIR>
          Load skills from these directories instead of auto-discovery (repeatable)

      --output-format <OUTPUT_FORMAT>
          Output format for prompt mode (defaults to text)

          Possible values:
          - text:        Plain text (default)
          - stream-json: One JSON event per line (Claude Code stream-json compatible)

      --tui
          Launch the full-screen TUI (requires an interactive terminal)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
